name: Build APK

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main   # You can change this if you use a different branch

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v2
        with:
          python-version: '3.7'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt update
          sudo apt install -y \
            build-essential \
            git \
            zip \
            unzip \
            openjdk-17-jdk \
            python3.7 \
            python3.7-venv \
            python3.7-distutils \
            libffi-dev \
            libssl-dev \
            libsqlite3-dev \
            zlib1g-dev \
            libjpeg-dev \
            libfreetype6-dev
          pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel cython buildozer

      - name: Build APK
        run: buildozer android debug

      - name: Upload APK
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v2
        with:
          name: MyApp-APK
          path: bin/*.apk
